page.layout: One printed page: a single text column on the left, with marginal notes in the right margin. Right margin: note "l.9." at the top, and a note at the foot "v.Maronitarum appendie. ad Geogr. Nub. s.8.".

main_text.p: distiu recitantur, risu explodunt[?]ur, ut nostrorum, in ipsorum rebus, insciriae argumentum.

Qui plurimas dicunt, 17. illi assignant praeter concubinas] 15. Abulfeda, Alkodai, Ahmed Iosephi filius &c. Liceat hic adscribere quae habet Maimonides in Moreh, l. 2. c. 40. ubi quomodo probandi sint Pseudoprophetae, docet his verbis, l.9.[illegible, ~14 letters] [illegible, ~38 letters] [illegible, ~33 letters] [illegible, ~36 letters] [illegible, ~36 letters] [illegible, ~37 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~22 letters] Modus autem ta-lem probandi, est ut perfectionem personae ipsius animad-vertas, & in factis ejus inquiras, & conversationem observes, signum autem praecipuum quo dignoscatur est, si abdicaverit voluptates corporeas & eas contemptui habuerit, (hic siquidem primus est gradus scientiae praeditorum, multo magis prophetarum) inprimis vero sensum illum qui juxta Aristotelem opprobrio nobis est, ac turpitudinem rei Venereae, ideoque hoc indicio detexit Deus omnes falso de afflatu Prophetico gloriabundos, ut ita patefieret veritas eam indagantibus, & ne in errorem inducantur. Haec ille. Quid igitur de isto qui totus in libidinem effusus, atque hoc inter praecipua muneris Prophetici privilegia habuit, statuendum? Uxorum ejus nomina recensent Historici, atque inter caeteras Zainab, quaev.Maronitarum appendie. ad Geogr. Nub. s.8.

page.notes: Arabic lines (eight lines of verse before "Modus autem") are not legible from the scan; the letter counts are approximate and the text is marked illegible throughout. "scientiæ praditorum" read as "praeditorum" with uncertainty; the word is not fully clear and may be misprinted. The text in the right margin with the reference mark "v" has no corresponding mark visible in the column. The "15." after "concubinas]" is printed as shown and its function is unclear. "Google" watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser mark and omitted.
